description: Gold retrieval queries. Each template is expanded for every species that has at least one chunk in the category; the relevant set is every chunk of that (species, category) cell. Indonesian templates mirror how the card pipeline and users phrase requests; English ones check the reverse language direction.

identity.text: Apa nama ilmiah dan famili ikan {common_name}?

physical_characteristics.text: Bagaimana ciri fisik, ukuran dan warna tubuh ikan {common_name}?
What does {common_name} look like and how large does it grow?

taste_texture.text: Bagaimana rasa dan tekstur daging ikan {common_name}?
How does {common_name} taste and what is its texture?

processing_methods.text: Bagaimana cara pengolahan ikan {common_name} menjadi produk?

commercial_uses.text: Apa nilai komersial dan pemanfaatan pasar ikan {common_name}?
What is the commercial importance of {common_name}?

substitutes.text: Ikan apa yang bisa menjadi pengganti {common_name}?
